Variants.Content: Hardfoot Town is located north of the Wall and is the settlement and gathering place of the Hardfoot Tribe of Free Folk. This place does not belong to the legal system of the Seven Kingdoms, nor does it have fixed official offices like the towns in the south; tribal kinship, hunting grounds, migration routes and the ability to escape the harsh winter determine its boundaries more than city walls and land deeds.
Entry Hardhome Local families also rely on water, roads, arable land, herds, and markets where goods can be exchanged; if any road, well, or dock fails, the price falls first on them.

Entry Hardhome They also recognize the accents, laws, and credentials of the known world; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but real distances must still be measured by wheel, oar, or horse's hoof.

Entry Hardhome If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Hardhome A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Hardhome They care about water sources, roads, cultivated land, herds, and markets where goods can be exchanged. They also look at whether seeds are left after harvesting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
